title: Antenna Kite
provenance: Original built-in ImageGen; source master retained; alpha crop and packed exports
description: Original biomechanical flyer candidate. Separate near and far root/tip articulation. Calm 2 s idle at 8 fps; optional one-shot 0.67 s dodge at 12 fps; static fallback. Shared placement origin (141,212) per 320×232 cell, facing left, 80 strip units; scale is fixed using maximum idle wing span. Calm idle or still only while a question is open. Does not include attack, hurt or defeated. Phone GIF uses an existing background crop and is not a game screenshot.

format_policy.runtime: single transparent WebP atlas + JSON frame timing; parsed as native Godot textures
format_policy.preview_only: Animated WebP (preferred) and GIF (legacy); not game imports
format_policy.verified_godot: 4.7.2 official rejects direct GIF and this animated WebP; use atlas for runtime
